title: A Changes run keeps the answers it refused in its artifact
acceptance: A run that refuses a model answer writes rejected.json beside run.json, even when the run then fails: one entry per refused answer in the order refused, { stage, attempt, beat?, refusal, answer, truncated? }, stage composition, illustrator (a figure the rendered check refused included) or router (only when a route could not be read). A run that refuses nothing writes no rejected.json.

No prompt and no credential is kept: the answer is the one claude-cli.js returns, with any echo of CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN redacted; each answer is cut at 65,536 characters and the file at 4 MiB, a cut entry marked truncated.
rejected.json is never committed to changes-data or served: both workflows' commit steps copy only <id>.json and index.json, held by a test.

changes-digest.yml and changes-public.yml upload run.json and rejected.json as the run's artifact with actions/upload-artifact pinned by full commit SHA, if: always(), kept 90 days; docs/plans/RISE-CHANGES.md says what the run writes, why (the audit's unlabelable L02 and L27), and that the artifact is public to signed-in GitHub users.

evidence.note: Branch changes/keep-rejected-answers, local (Windows, not pushed): npx vitest run scripts/changes/ src/core/changes/: 14 files, 246 passed; node scripts/ci-hygiene.mjs clean; node --test scripts/changes/digest.test.mjs 5 passed. Red first (8 failed: nothing kept, answer not redacted, no serializeRejected); green; red again with the answer redaction undone and the composition hook removed (4 failed), and with the redaction alone undone (2 failed: claude-cli and the run-level fake-token test); restored.

Both workflows: the artifact step follows the digest step, if: always(), upload-artifact pinned by 40-hex SHA, paths exactly run.json and rejected.json, retention 90, no credential; the commit step copies only $ID.json and index.json. Red with rejected.json added to changes-digest.yml's cp line (1 failed), restored. Not yet seen: a real workflow run uploading the artifact.

Review council fixes on the same branch, local (not pushed), each red first then green: (1) rejected.json rewritten synchronously at each refusal (red: ENOENT mid-run); (2) main takes its digest function, tested writing on a throw and writing nothing when nothing was refused (red: the real run was called); (3) an illustrator answer let go as a cue is kept with its reason (red: nothing kept); (4) the illustration.refused note carries its diagnostics, so a drawn-nothing answer is kept as 'nothing-drawn: the answer drew no picture' (red: bare rule); (5) a figure the rendered check refuses twice gives attempts 1 and 2 (red with the second keep removed); (6) continue-on-error on both upload steps, pinned (red: 2 failed). npx vitest run scripts/changes/ src/core/changes/ src/live/illustrator.test.js src/live/runtime.illustrator.test.js src/live/perception.test.js: 17 files, 312 passed; ci-hygiene clean. Still not seen: a real workflow run.

activity.summary: Opened, approved by the owner in the coordinating session on 2026-11-06 (not linked): the Phase 0 audit could not label refusals L02 and L27 because the refused answers were not kept.
Built on branch: rejected.json kept, redacted, bounded and uploaded with run.json
Review council fixes: synchronous rejected.json, main tested, cue and full refusals kept, upload cannot skip the commit; activity wording corrected

summary: Each model answer RISE refuses in a Changes run is kept, redacted and bounded, in rejected.json and uploaded with run.json as the workflow run's artifact, so a later audit can label what today's could not.
